verdict.rationale: A public roadmap is a fair ecosystem question for a web framework like Proa, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a roadmap, project board, or published statement of what the core team is working on. Docs, the GitHub README, benchmarks and update commands are adjacent material and do not count.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check a public roadmap to see what the core team is currently working on
